name: Sugar No. 11
read: Sugar No. 11 Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 17.16, 89 days to expiry 2027-02-16): at-the-money implied vol 26.9%, +0.8 pts vs 2026-11-13. 20-day realized vol 29.9%, so options trade at a discount of 3.0 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +3.6 (calls over puts). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-11-06 to 2026-11-19) call open interest rose 7,763 and puts fell 19,091; put/call OI 0.52 → 0.48, front futures 18.24 → 17.16. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +5,270 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 24.9% → 25.9%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 20 calls (26,862 lots) and 17 puts (17,212). Biggest 5-session builds: Mar 27 18.5 calls +4,517; Jul 27 18 calls +3,169. Biggest cut: Mar 27 21 calls -1,808.
